groups.root_cause: Terminal formatting is stripped only after the runner has already framed and tail-cut the output, so credential fragments split by escape sequences slip past redaction.
The carry is redacted as soon as the shorter credential matches, so the sensitive suffix of a longer registered credential that shares its prefix gets emitted in a later chunk.
The failure-excerpt path never gets ANSI-normalized, multiline-aware redaction, so a formatted multiline credential comes back whole in the excerpt.
The privacy filter treats the literal "[redacted]" marker as sensitive and withholds the entire text instead of passing the already-redacted content through.
The HTTP/SSE layer runs gate-data redaction on every response object, which rewrites non-gate payloads and adds confinement metadata to them.
The artifact endpoint parses and sanitizes stored artifacts instead of serving the stored bytes unchanged, which alters JSON formatting and strips escape bytes from non-gate artifacts like patches.
Prompt construction runs gate-output sanitization over every input, including the patch under review, which removes literal escape bytes from the source changes.
The new stdoutTruncated/stderrTruncated fields are added to the process result but nothing reads them.
confinementError is now always written and saved output is VT-normalized, so an older release reading results after a rollback can mistake the normalized text for a real confinement failure.
